doc.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021

title: First modern jazz group, jazz camp and first paid gigs
summary: At 17 she meets players at a jazz camp, forms a band in Newcastle, then goes to the Sydney Conservatorium; early pay.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. I met some musicians — I was 17 at the jazz camp. I went to a classical camp, found out about a jazz camp, so the next school holiday I went to that jazz camp. And that’s where the first proper like modern jazz group that me and Andrew Dickenson who is a drummer who teaches at Sydney Conservatorium. All of us are still playing. It was Adrian Mears on trombone, who is based in Europe; Nicki on bass; and John Foreman on piano, who actually in the “Idol” of Australia he’s done things like “Australian Idol” and all sorts of stuff. He was on TV and stuff like that. So we formed in New Castle, Australia, which is a hundred miles north of Sydney, we formed our first band and that group was together for a couple of years. And at the same time, after high school it’d be like a year and a bit of classical music course before we all moved to Sydney and I started doing the jazz course at the Sydney Conservatorium.
Do you recall what you got paid the first time you did a paying gig?

Well it wasn’t jazz, it was a little busking group, I’m pretty sure it was ten bucks each for a Coal Point School event. I do remember the group Blues by Five we had a couple of regular gigs. So I was the oldest at 17. And that was 40 bucks a gig. Not bad. And that was at the Grand Hotel bizarrely enough, on July 6th, I’m playing in the exact same, I’m playing at the Grand Hotel. Oh that was Rumours Tavern. But anyway, we had also a regular gig at the Grand Hotel and fast forward however many years that is, I’m playing there on July 6th.
I assume you’re going to let the audience know that.
In those kind of gigs, this would have been around what year?
From about, that band was formed in ’85 so, ’85 to ’88.
